Topic 3.5: Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives water to overcome daily challenges ● learners to sing a song on Jesus walking on water
2. appreciate the power of Jesus Christ daughter daughter did over death ●

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: JESUS CHRIST LIFE OF JESUS CHRIST
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

PART 1: Appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives water to overcome daily challenges ● learners to sing a song on Jesus walking on water

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives water to overcome daily challenges ● learners to sing a song on Jesus walking on water. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives water to overcome daily challenges ● learners to sing a song on Jesus walking on water.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives water to overcome daily challenges ● learners to sing a song on Jesus walking on water. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the power of Jesus Christ daughter daughter did over death ●

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the power of Jesus Christ daughter daughter did over death ●. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the power of Jesus Christ daughter daughter did over death ●.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the power of Jesus Christ daughter daughter did over death ●. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives water to overcome daily challenges ● learners to sing a song on Jesus walking on water)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ in your own words. (skill: appreciate the power of Jesus Christ daughter daughter did over death ●)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives water to overcome daily challenges ● learners to sing a song on Jesus walking on water.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the power of Jesus Christ daughter daughter did over death ●.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate Jesus’ power in their lives water to overcome daily challenges ● learners to sing a song on Jesus walking on water.
5. Be able to: appreciate the power of Jesus Christ daughter daughter did over death ●.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
